name: Imagined Music
author: WaxClub
origin: Your own AI chip (WaxBrain) + photos from Unsplash + public-domain art (The Met, Art Institute of Chicago)
license: Photos from Unsplash, credited to each photographer; artworks in the public domain (CC0), credited to each museum; scenes chosen by your AI chip
description: An AI visual director reads the lyrics and imagines the song: a slow, cinematic slideshow that follows its verses, moods and colors, behind the lyrics on your TV. Scenes alternate between photos, public-domain artworks and images of the feeling of each moment (love, longing, loneliness, anger...). In Immersive mode, only the images play, with a striking line of the lyrics fading in about every 30 seconds. Uses an AI chip from your WaxBrain (Gemini is free); photos come from Unsplash, credited to their photographers.
